projection_policy: Every unique substantive report field retained; only full input_hashes dictionary and checked_question_ids omitted from shared coverage content, separately machine-verified against all75 current files/170 IDs. All scope-only question_checks/conclusion/cross-reference retained; common fields exactly equal across both raw reports. This is a parent read aid, not a substitute reviewer input.

coverage_shared_and_complete_unique_fiel.grading_interpretation: All505 required facts compared with all170 literal asks and source-supported answers. Equivalent phrasing and implied actors are accepted; stipulated guards are not additional recital demands. Noncredited conditional clauses remain fully graded. Source-context transcription defects below do not change any actually requested fixed answer.

remaining_gaps.topic: An explicit grant of Elements is repeated, unlike printed margin Elements
remaining_gaps.proposed_question: A legally used Elemental Boon grants Elements through its effect text. It is then legally Repeated using Powerstorm. Does its explicit Element-grant instruction happen again, and are the card’s printed margin Elements gained again?
remaining_gaps.predetermined_answer: The explicit Element-grant instruction happens again, so its benefit can be received twice. Repeating does not grant the card’s printed margin Elements again; those were gained when the card was played.
minimum_asked_facts: Repeat resolves the explicit Element-grant effect again.
Printed margin Elements are not gained again.

primary_sources.label: Official FAQ .9v5ka9b: explicit Element-grant text repeats, printed card Elements do not
Original CORE p22 solo rule expressly names Elemental Boon as an ordinary core Power

primary_sources.transcription: Once this turn, target may Repeat a Power Card by paying its cost again.
primary_sources.role: Actual original-core Repeat producer; full native face/no expansion emblem inspected.

actual_prompt_overlap_assessment.literal_ask: do you gain its printed Elements again?
actual_prompt_overlap_assessment.assessment: Only margin Elements are asked. The fixed key adds the explicit-grant exception, but the asked map expressly and correctly classifies that sentence as key_context_not_required.

These ask retained modifiers/current thresholds, flexible-Element choice timing, Power-use/card-play counting, or already-owned Element eligibility. None requests the positive repeated-text grant branch.

remaining_gaps.why_novel: The official FAQ expressly distinguishes two Element-acquisition mechanisms within the same Repeat ruling. All existing asked facts permit a mistaken blanket rule that repeating can never grant Elements. The new ask isolates the source-defined positive exception, rather than changing a number, a printed payload or adding an arbitrary interaction. Its margin clause is disclosed regression overlap, not second novelty.

scope_assessment.producer_proof: Original CORE p22 identifies Elemental Boon in ordinary solo play; the applicable official FAQ explicitly names it as an Element-grant card whose text can be repeated. The fully viewed original-core Powerstorm supplies Repeat permission. No expansion-named or invented modifier is used.

scope_findings.correction: Classify Q36 as mixed supported/noncredited: numeric Growth Move Presence-arrow clause is unverified for original eight and earns0 current-base novelty; Add/reposition clauses remain base-supported. Retain the full question, key and all four grading facts.

primary_sources.observed: No original-eight Growth choice has a numeric Move Presence arrow. Original choices have Add Presence; Ocean additionally has Gather/Push. The permitted originals therefore do not supply that numeric-arrow producer.

families.family: Setup, intro alternatives, components, solo and balanced-board geometry
families.assessment: Pool/deck/initial Explore; own/supply setup; hidden random Blight; progression set-aside; remaining track disks; setup Blight exception;13disks/spare; solo eligibility/targeting; legal fitting balanced layout are directly asked. Exact individual Spirit setup counts and lore are payloads, not new procedures.

families.family: Spirit Phase, Growth, income, cards and resources
families.assessment: Order, chaining, option boundaries, waiting, track effects/Reclaim, outside-play permissions, gain/Forget/zones, Green Always/Regeneration and Ocean any-Ocean choice tested. Numeric Growth Move clause remains a graded conditional with no identified original-eight producer. Ocean Gather/Push mandatory follows directly from asked mandatory Growth plus Gather/Push rules.

families.family: Power timing, targets, Elements, thresholds, Range and Repeat
families.assessment: Defined positive/negative timing and eligibility branches, source/restriction/bonus ownership, optional lower Elements, no-chain/default retarget/location override, repayment versus cost limit represented. Explicit Elements from repeated text is the sole surviving gap G11-01; Q40 background cannot close it.

families.family: Invader sequence, Ravage/Build/Explore, Fear and outcomes
families.assessment: Eligibility snapshots per card, ordering and per-player completion, no-card omission, destruction/ordinary Fear and Terror, queued/new Fear cards, cleanup before outcomes, simultaneous Ravage and Dahan attacks, skip/source boundaries represented. Two-Ravage/card and mixed global/each clauses stay conditionally graded with zero unverified producer novelty.

families.family: Presence, Blight, movement, Damage/Health, protection, Remove/Replace and capacity
families.assessment: Source/recipient/protection boundaries, simultaneous/separate action units, destroyed disks, Blight pools/cascade, movement directions/destinations, fixed/dynamic Defend and traveling attribution, no stacking cap and source-defined removal/replacement rules represented. Existing unsupported modifiers/Health-worth removal/simultaneous multi-Blight/downgrade states retain conditional grading, zero novelty. Infinite Vitality is an actual original-core Dahan Health-bonus producer.

families.family: Original-eight special/innate and card procedures, action trees and source attribution
families.assessment: All16 panel faces and all33 named card faces compared. Ordinary printed Fear/Damage amounts, innate payload changes and further combinations do not create independent procedures. Bringer reveal selection is Q87; revealed cards remain earned/resolved by the already asked ordinary Fear machinery, not an additional automatic gain. Its per-Power/per-Invader cap is explicitly Q170; no fake location reset. No extra eligible producer or branch survived beyond G11-01.

Optional timeboxing, rewinds/mistake tolerance, tactical tips and reminder arrangements are table guidance, not distinct state-changing gameplay permissions. Optional difficulty/scoring, thematic, adversary/scenario, expansion/promo/aspect producers and expansion examples within broadly Core-labelled FAQs excluded. Sky and Cast Down native emblems independently confirm excluded examples. No blanket exclusion based solely on FAQ label.

stopping_assessment.reason: A surviving independent actual-ask gap defeats the zero-unresolved-gap stopping criterion irrespective of the two reported working passes. Do not dispatch or interpret this as a saturation PASS.

coverage_shared_and_complete_unique_fiel.scope_preservation: Retain every existing question and all505 required facts. The Q36 finding changes only current-base novelty metadata. Other working generalized/unverified clauses are not silently upgraded merely because their FAQ is labelled Core, and their conditional answers remain hard regression requirements. No universal absence claim is made about uncaptured components.

scope_only_fields.conclusion: All170 fixed answers and505 asked-map facts pass literal-ask/source checks. Overall review fails because Q36 overcredits an unverified Growth producer and working source transcriptions need the two corrections. The separate complete-corpus challenge also finds one actual-ask gap.
